coating_gap_um.semantic_meaning: Doctor blade / slot-die coating gap setting controlling wet film thickness

drying_temperature_c.handling: Forward-fill from batch/case header block; parse ranges like '60-80' as lower bound or midpoint

active_material_fraction_pct.semantic_meaning: Graphite active material mass fraction in dry electrode formulation

conductive_additive_fraction_pct.semantic_meaning: Conductive carbon black (Timcal Super C45) mass fraction in dry electrode formulation

binder_cmc_fraction_pct.semantic_meaning: Carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) binder mass fraction in dry electrode formulation

binder_sbr_fraction_pct.semantic_meaning: Styrene-butadiene rubber (SBR) latex binder mass fraction in dry electrode formulation

calendering_applied.semantic_meaning: Whether calendering compression rolls were applied to densify the dry coated electrode
calendering_applied.handling: In ASC, even numbered cases (40, 42, 44... 74) are calendered; odd numbered cases are uncalendered.

discharge_specific_capacity_cycle30_mah_.semantic_meaning: Experimental discharge specific capacity at cycle 30 normalized by electrode active mass
discharge_specific_capacity_cycle30_mah_.presence: Explicitly present in ASC (69 positive cells). Absent from AS (which records D20 and D50).

active_mass_mg.semantic_meaning: Gravimetric mass of active graphite material on the electrode disc

electrode_thickness_um.semantic_meaning: Total thickness of coated electrode including current collector copper foil

porosity_pct.semantic_meaning: Electrode pore volume fraction calculated from skeletal density and geometric volume

cell_capacity_mah.semantic_meaning: Nominal theoretical cell capacity calculated assuming theoretical graphite capacity of 372 mAh/g
cell_capacity_mah.note: NOT an experimental discharge target; represents active_mass_mg * 0.372.
